summary: The algorithm achieves a perfect score of 100 on all 10 test cases, confirmed for the third consecutive iteration (iter-3 through iter-5). Results are byte-identical to iteration 4, verifying full determinism. The problem is solved at its maximum achievable score.
key_points: CONFIRMED: Score 100 on all 10 test cases, matching prediction exactly. Per-case operation counts range from 1982 to 1990 (average 1986.0), well under the 4n=4000 budget for n=1000.

The circular buffer rotation sort with k=5 BFS-optimal endgame uses at most 1990 operations in the worst observed case, comfortably below both the theoretical worst-case bound of 1995 (2n−5) and the score-100 threshold of 2001 (2n+1).

Three consecutive iterations at score 100 with identical outputs confirm the algorithm is stable and deterministic. No further optimization is possible — the score ceiling has been reached. Recommend APPROVE and end campaign.
